hooks.command: if [ "$FILE_PATH" = "hardware-configuration.nix" ] || [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *hardware-configuration.nix* ]]; then echo 'Error: hardware-configuration.nix is auto-generated by nixos-generate-config. Edit configuration.nix or modules/ instead.' >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ "$FILE_PATH" = "flake.lock" ] || [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *flake.lock* ]]; then echo 'Error: flake.lock is auto-managed. Run "nix flake update" to update inputs.' >&2; exit 1; fi
if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *.nix ]]; then nix flake check; fi
